ICS 23.100.40PGD 36Revised Standard from Last Update.1. SCOPEThis standard specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for taper male stud tee bodies (stud run) made from bar stock for use in oilhydraulic systems.2. REFERENCESThe standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which, through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreement based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent edition of these standards.
